attempts.text:
Car2 makes all the trips, since car1 at Suryagadhi is further from most of the stranded groups. Car1 stays idle. Tarkeshwar farm is deferred because reaching it costs about 186 driving minutes for 80 minutes of penalty.

Assumptions:
- The Thakre farm–Tadi temple road and the Tarkeshwar farm–Dhunche school road are treated as unusable because of fast floodwater.
- Tadi temple is not a drop-off point, so everyone is brought to Kalika hospital.
- The pensioners and the frail senior citizens are treated as elderly.

Trips: (1) four elderly from Likhu temple, (2) four adults from Gajuri farm, (3) two elderly from Galchhi village, (4) two injured and two elderly from Nilkantha market, (5) two elderly from Nilkantha market plus one elderly and one adult from Tadi temple. Two adults from Tadi temple, two from Thakre farm and four from Tarkeshwar farm are deferred.
